headline: Zodiac Clothing files depository participant compliance certificate
hook: Routine compliance filing submitted to the exchange
summary: Zodiac Clothing Company Limited has submitted a compliance certificate under the SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018. This is a routine regulatory filing required for listed companies. The submission ensures adherence to depository rules regarding share dematerialisation. For an Indian retail investor, this carries no direct financial impact.
why_it_matters: No financial consequence for retail investors

headline: Zodiac Clothing Company files AGM Scrutinizer's report and voting results
hook: AGM voting results submitted to exchanges
summary: Zodiac Clothing Company Limited has submitted the Scrutinizer's report and voting results for its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026. This regulatory filing completes the standard post-AGM compliance requirements for the listed apparel maker. Retail shareholders can review the accepted resolutions and voting patterns on the exchange portals.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance update with no immediate financial impact.

headline: Zodiac Clothing Company issues general corporate updates to the exchange
hook: Routine corporate disclosure from Zodiac Clothing
summary: Zodiac Clothing Company Limited has submitted a general update filing to the stock exchange. The company provided no specific financial figures, operational milestones, or material events in this notification. Routine regulatory filings of this nature do not alter the company's financial standing or operational outlook. Indian retail investors holding shares can treat this as standard administrative compliance.
why_it_matters: No material impact on share price or company operations
